scripts.dev: node scripts/check-node.js && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-warnings" tsx server.ts
scripts.distribution:sync:full: npm run toolchains:fetch:full && npm run distribution:prepare:full
scripts.distribution:sync:core: npm run toolchains:fetch:core && npm run distribution:prepare:core
scripts.build:windows:local: npm run build:executor && npm run build:server && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.local.conf.json --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:windows:core:local: npm run distribution:sync:core && npm run build:executor && npm run build:server && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.core.local.conf.json --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
